series.summary: Rick locks down the house and establishes the rule of six, but an elevator flashback materializes Cousin Nicky in the living room until Rick shoots him in the shoulder.

cuts.voiceover_text: To contain the parasites, Rick seals the house behind blast shields, writing six on the board to track the only real family members.

The lockdown cracks when Jerry recalls being trapped in an elevator after a musical. The family fondly relives their panic, rescued only when a stranger named Cousin Nicky dropped through the ceiling hatch.
Back in the room, the memory becomes real. Cousin Nicky is suddenly standing among them, casually urging the family to unlock the doors.
Rick immediately shoots Nicky in the shoulder. With seven people present, their minds are compromised. If their own memories are fake, who is actually real?
